memories.entities: StructuredBuffer, SDF, Metal, emitter light, SDL_shadercross, Texture2D, SkyVis, atlas
memories.text: CRITICAL Metal bug (build-verified 2026-05-30): SDL_shadercross @ 6b06e55c mis-binds sampler textures on Metal — upload reaches GPU but fragment shader Texture2D.Load/.Sample returns 0 for every fragment. This silently zeroed SDF shadow march (s=0 → shadow=0), killing all emitter light in-game. Fix: SDF and SkyVis moved from Texture2D to StructuredBuffer (fragment storage buffers). Emitters migrated 2026-05-29; SDF + SkyVis followed 2026-05-30. Atlas (sampler slot 0) is the ONLY remaining sampler texture; all per-tile lighting data is in storage buffers. | When: 2026-05-30 | Root cause of all emitter light being invisible in-game on Metal; architectural decision to use storage buffers for all per-tile lighting data.

memories.entities: lit_level::LOW, gpu_total, lighting_*, color_pixel_grayscale, R8G8B8A8_UNORM, sprite.frag, mem_dim, sub-tile vision frontier
memories.text: Sub-tile vision FRONTIER: three whole-tile vision treatments are now feathered across the boundary tile instead of snapping at its edge. (1) `lit_level::LOW` keeps the normal sprite; `sprite.frag` reproduces `color_pixel_grayscale` (av = 85*(r+g+b)>>8, max(av*5>>3, 1)) and ramps it in — atlas is R8G8B8A8_UNORM so shader sees byte-identical values to the CPU filter. (2) Remembered tiles lerp BOTH `mem_dim` and the CPU tint passthrough so the edge falls through to `gpu_total` (feathering dim alone would ramp toward full unlit albedo — a bright rim). (3) A never-seen tile's `lighting_*` overlay fades its alpha. | Eliminates the loudest per-tile artefact (hard grayscale swap at LOW) and prevents a bright rim on remembered-tile edges.

GI buffers are scalar (RW)StructuredBuffer<float>, 4 floats/tile (rgb+pad), tile-res, x-major index [(x*map_h+y)*4 + c] — no transpose (unlike old RC texture). Readonly inputs declared StructuredBuffer (not RW) so D3D12 doesn't default them read-write. Emitter + SDF buffers require COMPUTE_STORAGE_READ create flag. Compute HLSL register spaces: readonly storage (tN,space0), RW (uN,space1), uniform (bN,space2). | D3D12 buffer layout and binding constraints

memories.entities: sprite.frag, cata_tiles::frontier_mask, debug_mode, smoothstep, vis_edge, marching squares
memories.text: `cata_tiles::frontier_mask` packs the 8 neighbours' 'same side as me' bits; `sprite.frag` bilinearly interpolates the four corner means (marching squares). The remap MUST be `smoothstep(0.5, 1.0, cov)` — anchoring at 0.5 keeps the whole feather INSIDE the treated tile (on a straight frontier, both corners on the shared edge average to exactly 0.5). Knob: `vis_edge`. Debug view: `debug_mode == 15`. | Using any band centred on 0.5 would leave the shared edge at half-treatment (a staircase).

calculate_mapgen_weights() parallelizes JSON generator setup via parallel_for but keeps Lua generator setup serial on the main thread. | Explains why Lua mapgen setup is a potential performance bottleneck compared to JSON generators.

memories.text: Sprite tint is pure colour — the composite comes from light_mode. draw_from_id_string sets gpu_light_r/g/b to flat 1.0f for every sprite. The old CPU-lightmap read path (gpu_light_r/g/b = lm[idx].max()) and its lum > 0.001f 'lightmap not generated yet' fallback to white tint are DELETED. That test used per-tile BRIGHTNESS as a proxy for readiness, so a pitch-dark but visible tile rendered at full unlit albedo with shadows discarded. | Architecture change: removed brightness-based readiness heuristic that caused dark tiles to render unlit

memories.entities: occ_raster.comp, occ_base.comp, jfa_seed.comp, occluder_capture, SDF, occ_soft_gain
memories.text: Sprite-alpha occluder pipeline: `occluder_capture` records per-frame sprite footprints (quad centre, size, rotation in TILE units + atlas rect). `occ_base.comp` seeds old tile-square only where nothing was captured (off-camera fallback). `occ_raster.comp` inverts each quad's transform per subcell and averages 4x4 alpha taps into a coverage field. `jfa_seed.comp` converts coverage to occupancy via a world-locked Bayer threshold, so partial occluders seed a stable fraction of subcells. The SDF now carries the artwork's real silhouette instead of one binary flag per tile replicated into 64 subcells. Knob: `occ_soft_gain`. | Architecture fact: replaces per-tile binary occlusion with per-sprite alpha-based SDF.
Passing a null texture in a sprite_batcher segment causes D3D12 command list corruption → crash at next GPU call. Never pass null. | Critical crash gotcha in the rendering pipeline.

Category thresholds fire via test_crossing_threshold() when a character crosses a category strength threshold, resolved by get_threshold_mutation_for_tier. | Architecture fact: defines how mutation tier thresholds are triggered

A single shared `trace_shadow(origin, dir, dist, k, steps)` function is used for BOTH emitters and the sun. The sun previously had a hardcoded k=4/16/8.0 copy. Sun passes dist=8.0 (directional reach) plus shadow_k/shadow_steps knobs and retains its sky_vis>0.01 gate (cannot reach roofed tiles). | Eliminated code duplication between sun and emitter shadow tracing

Storage buffers hold the CPU array directly in x-major layout (arr[x*H+y]) with no transpose. SDF buffer is a verbatim memcpy; SkyVis is per-element float convert. Shader indexes Buf[x*sdf_map_h + y] with x/y clamped. No row/col swap needed (that was only for the old row-major texture Load). | Architecture decision for GPU buffer layout in the rendering pipeline

Sub-tile vision carve: `sprite.frag` marches the same SDF toward the player and multiplies the result in, so wall corners cut sight as a smooth curve instead of a tile staircase. It can only SUBTRACT inside a tile the CPU already granted (cannot reveal anything). Replaced a dead 4.5 MB `VisBuf` field that was built, blurred, and uploaded every player move with no reader. Knobs: `vis_curve`, `vis_radius`. | Smooths vision at tile boundaries and removes unused 4.5 MB buffer

memories.entities: camera offset, cam_off, emitters, lighting, tile_width
memories.text: Correct world_pos → map-tile camera offset formula is `cam_off = op / tile_width - o`. The early bug used `cam_off = o / tile_px + 0.5`, which was ~135 tiles off, making all emitters appear 135+ tiles away → zero attenuation → no visible lighting. | Bug diagnosis: confusing tile-index `o` with pixel offset `op` in the formula caused complete lighting failure.

Constraint: SDL_Renderer is still alive because copy_surface_to_dynamic_atlas creates SDL_Textures used as lookup keys for find_gpu_texture_full. Cannot delete SDL_Renderer until the atlas switches to a pure GPU key (target: phase 2i-B-7f). | Blocks full removal of SDL_Renderer dependency.

refresh_display() in sdltiles.cpp orchestrates the frame: begin_frame on tile_batcher/ui_batcher/fonts (ring advance) → device.begin_frame + acquire swapchain → tile_batcher.begin_pass with LOADOP_CLEAR → flush_tile_sprites (terrain/mob/item/vehicles) → set white_tex + flush_ui_rects → flush_font_glyphs → end_pass → submit_frame. | Defines the exact per-frame rendering order and pass structure.

memories.text: GI is computed on the GPU by `gi_compute_pass` (Stage 1 of `plans/done/GI_COMPUTE_AND_PERF_PLAN.md`, 2026-06-18). It replaced the fragment-based `radiance_cascade_pass` (+ `rc.frag`/`rc_bounce.frag`) because the fragment approach failed `SDL_CreateGPUGraphicsPipeline` root-signature construction on D3D12 (fragment storage buffer with no leading sampler). Compute uses a distinct binding model that avoids this issue. | D3D12 root-signature bug with fragment storage buffers; compute binding model is a workaround

Main menu is safe from the GPU radiance issue because it classifies as 'unlit' (g == nullptr, so world_present is false) and unlit never multiplies by GPU radiance — not because of a brightness fallback. | Architectural explanation for why main menu was unaffected by the lighting bug

User's token-cost workflow preferences for Cataclysm-BN: don't paste full game logs (tail ~200 lines, filter ERROR|WARN); read files once then edit in sequence; use smart_outline → smart_unfold instead of reading large files whole. | Involving: user | Efficiency preferences to reduce token usage during sessions

In Cataclysm-BN-Forked, the GPU instance-queue lifecycle (tile sprites, UI rects, font glyphs) is managed in render_state (src/lighting/render_state.cpp); clear_frame_queues and clear_tile_queue are declared at render_state.h:321/323. Since phase 2i-B-7g, ui_adaptor::redraw_invalidated() (src/ui_manager.cpp:270) does NOT call clear_frame_queues() up front. Instead, each ui_adaptor owns a retained draw slice; only invalidated adaptors clear and repopulate their own slice during redraw_cb, then all slices are recomposited in z-order via render_state::append_slice (rects-then-glyphs per slice). Tile sprites are NOT in adaptor slices: redraw_invalidated clears the tile queue once, and cata_tiles::draw()/draw_om() re-clear and repopulate it as window callbacks, following a different lifecycle than UI adaptor slices. This retained-slice architecture ensures a partial redraw no longer wipes unrelated windows.

memories.entities: gi_field.comp.hlsl, SDF sphere-march, field_buf_, gi_bounce.comp.hlsl, GI compute pipeline, gi_compute_pass, gi_buf_, SDL_GPU
memories.text: GI compute pipeline uses two dispatches: pass 1 (field) gathers occluded emitter radiance via SDF sphere-march into field_buf_; pass 2 (bounce) marches N=16 rays through the field with 1/(1+t) falloff (stop at walls) into gi_buf_. numthreads(8,8,1), dispatch ceil(W/8)×ceil(H/8). SDL_GPU auto-inserts compute→compute barrier on field_buf_ and compute-write→graphics-read barrier on gi_buf_. | Core GI architecture
Files in lighting/ directory must define the dbg macro themselves; it is not provided globally. | Build friction item that costs a build cycle if missed

memories.entities: Chebyshev BFS, sdf_pass.cpp, shader indexing, SDF, sdf_bilinear
memories.text: SDF sampling uses 4-tap bilinear (`sdf_bilinear()`) on a tile-resolution Chebyshev BFS SDF (computed in `sdf_pass.cpp:compute_sdf_cpu`). Bilinear smooths diamond-faceted sawtooth penumbrae caused by integer per-tile jumps. Cell-origin convention uses floor/frac matching old `(int)p.x` to keep shadows glued to occluder edges. Residual squarish directionality is inherent to Chebyshev; Euclidean distance transform is future work. | Architecture decision for shadow quality

memories.text: Confirmed fix for Phase 7 black screen: moved emitter data and SDF from StructuredBuffer (space4) to Texture2D fragment samplers (register(tN, space2), same space as Atlas). EmitterTex is 4×64 RGBA32F (row=emitter index, col0=pos+radius, col1=color+falloff). SdfTex is Texture2D<float>. Upload reuses xfer_[write_slot_] since sizeof(gpu_emitter)=64=4×float4=one texture row. | Texture2D samplers in space2 are correctly reflected by SDL_shadercross on all backends, unlike fragment StructuredBuffers in space4.

Submap persistence lives in src/mapbuffer.cpp (mapbuffer, per-dimension via MAPBUFFER_REGISTRY). An OMT is a full vertical pillar of 2x2 submaps across z -10..10, stored in SQLite via world::read_map_omt/write_map_omt. | Defines how map data is persisted to disk

render_state.cpp/h is a singleton (get_render_state()) that owns the GPU device, sprite batchers, and queues. sprite_batcher uses instance-batched draws with one pass per batcher. shader_compiler handles HLSL→SPIRV-Cross compilation with embedded SPRITE_VERT_HLSL in sprite_batcher.cpp. | Key architectural patterns for the GPU rendering pipeline
Colored indirect light / GI has been moved to GPU COMPUTE (Stage 1), superseding the previous RC fragment approach. | Architecture migration from fragment shader to compute shader for GI

Rule: Never use fragment StructuredBuffer (space4) with SDL_shadercross @ 6b06e55c on D3D12. Use Texture2D samplers (space2) for fragment-stage data access. To restore proper StructuredBuffer support, bump SDL_shadercross GIT_TAG in CMakeLists.txt to a commit that correctly reflects fragment storage buffers. | Critical constraint to avoid regression

In the test suite, a Catch2 listener CataListener (registered via CATCH_REGISTER_LISTENER in tests/test_main.cpp) calls rng_set_engine_seed(m_config->rngSeed()) in sectionStarting, meaning the game RNG is re-seeded from --rng-seed at the start of EVERY Catch2 Section, not per test case. | Important architectural detail: RNG determinism is scoped to Sections, not individual test cases.
Design decision: desaturation is applied, but goggles/underwater states override the desaturation effect.

EmitterTex layout: 4×64 RGBA32F texture. Row = emitter index. Col 0 = (pos_x, pos_y, pos_z, radius). Col 1 = (r, g, b, falloff). Upload reuses xfer_[write_slot_] (same bytes as SSBO since sizeof(gpu_emitter)=64=4×float4=one texture row).

sprite_instance field semantics: negative src_u/src_v = flipped; light_mul < 0 means memorized tile carrying -(distance in tiles); pad2 > 0.5 = hover outline, < -0.5 = encoded frontier mask; face_amt is packed (floor = octant 0..7 E/SE/S/SW/W/NW/N/NE, frac = amount 0..0.999); light_mode: 0=unlit, 1=gpu_lit, 2=memory. | Non-obvious encoding details needed for any sprite_instance modification

memories.entities: jfa_seed.comp, SDF, occluder_capture, occ_base.comp, occ_soft_gain, occ_raster.comp
memories.text: Sprite-alpha occluder system: `occluder_capture` records per-frame sprite footprints (quad centre, size, rotation in TILE units + atlas rect). `occ_base.comp` seeds old tile-square only where nothing was captured (off-camera fallback). `occ_raster.comp` inverts each quad's transform per subcell and averages 4x4 alpha taps into a coverage field. `jfa_seed.comp` converts coverage to occupancy via world-locked Bayer threshold. SDF now carries the artwork's real silhouette instead of one binary flag per tile replicated into 64 subcells. Knob: `occ_soft_gain`. | Replaces binary per-tile occlusion with per-sprite alpha-based SDF

memories.text: SDL_shadercross@6b06e55c mis-reflects fragment StructuredBuffer resources at space4 on D3D12, causing a root-signature mismatch (E_INVALIDARG) and a silent black screen. Fragment lighting data must bind at space2 in a single SDL_BindGPUFragmentStorageBuffers call. The SDL_shadercross GIT_TAG in CMakeLists.txt must be bumped before reintroducing space4. | Bug diagnosis and workaround: using space4 for fragment StructuredBuffers on D3D12 produces a silent black screen due to SDL_shadercross reflection bug.

memories.entities: debug_mode, smoothstep, marching squares, vis_edge, sprite.frag, cata_tiles::frontier_mask
memories.text: `cata_tiles::frontier_mask` packs the 8 neighbours' 'same side as me' bits; `sprite.frag` bilinearly interpolates the four corner means (marching squares). The remap MUST be `smoothstep(0.5, 1.0, cov)` — anchoring at 0.5 keeps the whole feather INSIDE the treated tile (a band centred on 0.5 would leave the shared edge at half-treatment, creating a staircase). Knob: `vis_edge`. Debug view: `debug_mode == 15`. | The smoothstep(0.5,1.0) anchor is a hard constraint to avoid a visible staircase artefact on straight frontiers.
